messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P1] cross-region routing anomaly detected — increased 5xx and latency for eu-west2 traffic being steered to us-east1. Auto-runbooks triggered. @channel please ack if you're oncall and can triage

alex (eng-runtime): acked. seeing 502 spikes in the eu-west2 frontends starting ~09:12 UTC. spilling to us-east1 and causing request rejections there.

tina (oncall): I'm on it. pulling metrics + traces now. can someone share recent steering policy changes?

jay (netops): no config pushes in the last 6h from netops. I ran a quick check on the geo-prober and saw repeated probe failures for eu-west2 -> health-check endpoint returned 500 intermittently.

alex (eng-runtime): minimal deploys from runtime in last 12h. logs show errors at the routing layer: "policy_eval: selected region=us-east1 for request with origin eu-west2 despite affinity=eu-west2". putting snippet:```logs
[09:12:21] policy_eval: origin=eu-west2, latency_est(eu-west2)=85ms, latency_est(us-east1)=52ms, selected=us-east1, pin_state=ENABLED
[09:12:22] ingress: upstream_reject 502 code=upstream_unhealthy
```

tina (oncall): interesting — pin_state=ENABLED but evaluator still chose us-east1. could be a bug in the latency comparator under AZ ejection scenarios. switching to mitigation: pin eu-west2 for affected prefixes.

jay (netops): prepping a quick route pin. command i plan to run:```bash
rw steer pin --prefix /v1/generate --region eu-west2 --timeout 15m --force
```

emma (product): FYI, major EU customers reported errors ~09:13-09:18 UTC. @raj can you summarize customer impact so we can update status page?

raj (cust-succ): pinged top 3 affected accounts. two reported degraded generation responses, one flagged increased error rates in EU region. estimate ~3% of overall requests failing but concentrated on heavy EU tenants. drafting status update now.

alex (eng-runtime): pinned for prefixes that match heavy traffic. after pin, I see errors drop for those prefixes in the next 60s. however other prefixes still being misrouted because of fallback rules.

maya (sre): noticed that the AZ ejection for eu-west2-a happened at 09:11, and the health cache TTL was 10s — prober flapped which fed noisy latency estimates into the steering logic. suspect noise -> comparator gave consistent lower median for us-east1.

jay (netops): I can mute the geo-prober inputs to steering temporarily. planning: set probe weight to 0 for 5m while we stabilize. command:```bash
rw steer update-policy --name latency-based --set probe_weight=0 --duration 5m
```

alex (eng-runtime): +1 to mute probe. also enabling stricter affinity enforcement so pin overrides latency for 10m until we fix evaluator math.```bash
rw steer feature-flag --set enforce_pin_strict=true --duration 10m
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for config rollback (steering-generator v2.14 -> v2.13). CI checks passed.

tina (oncall): rolling back to 2.13 now. watching request rates and 5xx.

[~09:25 UTC] alex (eng-runtime): after pin + probe mute + rollback, overall 5xx dropped to baseline. us-east1 no longer receiving excess EU-origin traffic. latencies normalized for eu-west2.

raj (cust-succ): status.redwood.ai updated: "Partial outage impacting some EU customers for generation APIs. Mitigation in progress. Next update in 30 minutes." customers responded positively to fast acknowledgement.

emma (product): good call on pin+rollback. we should prepare post-incident comms with root cause: interplay between AZ ejection -> noisy probe -> latency comparator bug.

jay (netops): collecting traceroute + NAT translations from affected backends to validate there was no path blackhole. initial checks clear.

maya (sre): creating a short playbook note: - consider smoothing prober outputs over 30s window - treat pin_state as highest priority in comparator - add alerts for rapid probe flapping. assigning to alex + jay for follow-up.

alex (eng-runtime): will own comparator fix and add a feature flag + thorough test. estimate 2d for a proper patch and 4h for a canary.

jay (netops): will add probe smoothing and an operator metric for probe-flap-rate. estimate 1d.

tina (oncall): handing over to maya for overnight. my summary: mitigated by pin + probe mute + steering rollback. customer impact limited to ~3% of EU requests for ~20 minutes before mitigation. follow-ups assigned: comparator patch (alex), probe smoothing (jay), customer comms (emma/raj).

maya (sre): taking handoff — I'll monitor metrics for next 6h and escalate if recurrence. please post-runbook edits before end of day.

incident-bot: NOTE: runbook updated: "geo-steer: handle AZ ejection probe flapping". assigned owners: alex, jay, emma.

alex (eng-runtime): quick note — I saved the mitigation commands to the ops-runbook and included the exact rw commands and rollback hashes.

raj (cust-succ): will follow up with affected customers with timeline + mitigation summary once postmortem draft is ready.

emma (product): marking incident impact as P1 and assigning postmortem. owners alex + jay. ETA postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow.

meya (typo-bot): (noisy message suppressed)

maya (sre): closing this thread for active paging; will re-open if we see recurrence. thanks all 🙏
